name: P448

Low: Jesse Pink $225; John White - Gold $235; Jack models $245; high: Antibes Suede $345. Marked down e.g. Jack Terra $196 (was $245), excluded.

notes: us.p448.com returned 503 to one curl, then served normally on retry (StylodexBot UA); WebFetch confirmed 'United States / USD'.
Free-shipping threshold conflicts: homepage banner and FAQ say 'Free shipping on US orders $200+', the shipping policy says free ground over $300 and a flat $9 below. Left empty.

FAQ: 'Duties and taxes are included with every order, so the price you see is the price you pay'; 'Our sneakers are all designed and locally sourced in Italy', made in factories in Italy and Spain. About page: 'Handcrafted in Marche, Italy'; footer P448 s.r.l. with an Italian VAT number.
Refund policy: returns within 14 days of receiving the order; '$8 processing fee' deducted from every refund.
Shipping policy: 'We ship to all countries from our US site excluding Australia and New Zealand.'
Sizes: Size options EU 35–50 across most styles; 51–55 on a handful of men's styles. FAQ: 'P448 sizing is unique and sneaker specific'.
FashionUnited (2018): 'First launched in 2014' by Italian designers Andrea Curti and Marco Samorè; StreetTrend LLC and Panda srl bought a majority stake.
